Bug_Details:
Calling getAnnotation on an annotation that is not retained at runtime Calling getAnnotation on an annotation that does not have its Retention set to
RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME will always return null.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the line where getAnnotation is called on a NonRuntime annotation, which is not retained at runtime. This will always return null.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method of AnnotationBugDemo, which attempts to retrieve a NonRuntime annotation that is not retained at runtime, causing it to return null and the test to fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test result shows that the method'showBug' returned 'Annotation not found', which confirms that the annotation was not retained at runtime, thus triggering the NonRuntimeAnnotation bug.
